source.source_name: Regnskaber — XBRL / Inline XBRL annual-report documents (DCCA taxonomy)
source.license: Free / open; same CVR reuse terms

headers_required.name: Accept-Encoding
headers_required.note: documents are gzip-compressed even when Content-Type is text/xml; decompress on read

transport.record_path: xbrli:xbrl (XBRL instance root); facts are child elements with contextRef

pagination.note: One document per URL. Discovery and the list of documents come from the cvr_offentliggoerelser source.

transport.rate_limit: be polite; documents are static files

parsing.notes: Parse the XBRL instance: build a context map (id -> entity scheme/identifier, period instant or start/end, scenario/segment dimensions incl. cmn:ConsolidatedSoloDimension and typed board-member dimensions), then iterate facts. For each fact: resolve contextRef (period + consolidated/solo) and unitRef (iso4217 currency). DCCA namespaces: gsd (general/identity), fsa (financial line items), cmn (common/boards), sob (statements). Listed groups add ifrs-full + ESEF. For application/xhtml+xml (iXBRL) extract ix: facts from the XHTML; for application/xml parse the plain XBRL directly (simpler). Skip image/tiff and application/pdf (unstructured). Note taxonomy typo: gsd:PredingReportingPeriodEndDate.

mapping_rules.financial_facts: Map fsa:* concept QNames to internal line items; attach period + currency (unitRef iso4217) + consolidated/solo from the resolved context.
mapping_rules.board_members: cmn:NameAndSurnameOfMemberOfSupervisoryBoard (+ Title); cmn:NameAndSurnameOfMemberOfExecutiveBoard (+ Title) — match name/title by shared context id.

fixture_requirements: identity/management-review interim instance (Maersk Q1-2026 sample) — no fsa: figures
full annual report with fsa: income statement + balance sheet line items in DKK (class B/C small/medium company, Danish GAAP)
listed group with IFRS/ESEF + LEI + consolidated and solo contexts
iXBRL (application/xhtml+xml) document requiring ix: fact extraction
legacy image/tiff document (must be skipped as unstructured)
gzip-compressed response served as text/xml (decompression path)

live_test_plan.smoke: GET the Maersk DELAARSRAPPORT application/xml URL; gzip-decode; assert gsd:IdentificationNumberCvrOfReportingEntity == 22756214 and a resolvable ctx-1 period 2026-01-01..2026-03-31.
live_test_plan.full: For a batch of CVR numbers, discover documents via cvr_offentliggoerelser, download each application/xml/xhtml document, parse facts, and assert currency + period resolve. Gate full runs behind explicit env flags.
